answer: Deposits are visible in shale, and beacon reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 20 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tundra account. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 19 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
